text:
marie: quick sync on the 'golden path' for the inference advisor — want to lock MVP scope for the next sprint. TL;DR: recommendations (batching/caching/quant) + eval-triggered alerts. keep it lean, pilot w/ 3 customers.

ajay: sounds good. can we be explicit about what "MVP" *doesn't* include? e.g., no autoscaling policy changes, no tenant-aware batch packing, no private on-prem bundle for launch?

marie: exactly. MVP DOs: 1) per-route recommendations UI + API, 2) one-click apply for suggested quant/profile, 3) eval-triggered alerting with basic webhook/email delivery, 4) acceptance metrics + simple audit log. MVP DONTs: advanced rollout automation, built-in KMS integration (we'll surface hooks), and multi-tenant dynamic batching.

liam: engineering note: for quant recommendations we'll ship a ruleset + confidence score. rolling apply will be manual via API. that keeps runway short. estimate 3 wks eng + 1 wk hardening if no surprises.

sofia: from product-ops POV we need acceptance criteria. propose: pilot on 3 customers, p95 latency regression <=5% vs baseline, recommendation acceptance >=30% within 2 weeks, and eval-alert false-positive rate <=10% over pilot. thoughts?

katie-sre: add SLO gating: any recommendation that could increase p99 by >10% must be blocked. also need an ops runbook for alert floods (rate limit + auto-silence).

marie: agreed on SRE gating. I'll add the runbook item. also stakeholder ask: show per-model cost delta estimate when applying quant. that's a must-have for pilot sign-off.

ajay: question on eval-triggered alerts: do we want an on-device thresholding option or just server side for MVP? on-device adds a lot of work.

liam: server-side only for MVP. we can expose a compact config that customers can pull into their infra later. sample alert config we plan to support (YAML):
```yaml
alert_name: eval_regression_high_precision
trigger: eval.delta_concordance < -0.05
window: 24h
actions:
  - webhook: https://hooks.example.com/ops
  - email: ops@example.com
confidence_threshold: 0.7
severity: high
```

sofia: like the sample. need to make sure UI surfaces 'why' (explainability): show which prompt set failed and example diffs.

marie: pilot gating checklist draft: 1) onboarding docs + quickstart (30 min), 2) 3 pilot customers live, 3) metrics dashboard (latency/cost/acceptance) hooked to console, 4) runbook & playbook staged, 5) legal sign-off for sharing anonymized evals.

katie-sre: runbook snippets: how to mute noisy alerts, rollback applied quant profiles, and revert caching changes. add CLI commands for emergency rollback.

ajay: one more ask from field: customers want 'suggested quant level' + predicted quality delta per prompt set. we'll include a basic estimate (mean-concordance delta) in the MVP output. label it as heuristic.

liam: engineering risk: predicting quality delta reliably across long-tail prompts is hard. we'll flag low-confidence suggestions and block auto-apply. good enough for pilot.

marie: decision: ship server-side eval-alerts + recommendations + dashboard for pilot. exclude on-prem private bundle and advanced autoscaling. acceptance thresholds = sofia's + katie-sre's gating. next steps: liam to queue eng tasks, ajay to draft UX mocks + sample API, sofia to create pilot customer list and outreach.

liam: I'll break down tasks and post sprint estimates by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: I'll put up a quick Figma with the recommendation card and the 'apply' flow by afternoon.

sofia: reaching out to 5 customers, will shortlist 3 who are comfortable with eval sharing.

deploy-bot: reminder — please add the new feature flag `inference_advisor_mvp` to the launch matrix before any external preview.

marie: thanks all — filing this as the scope lock for the sprint. tagging next steps in the roadmap doc. :+1:
